URL: https://caliber.az/en/post/kazakhstan-suspends-oil-exports-via-novorossiysk-after-tanker-attacks
Caliber.az citing Bloomberg, 21 Jul 2026 — Kazakhstan suspended oil exports via CPC route to Novorossiysk until end of week after series of drone attacks on tankers. Shipowners reluctant to send vessels due to security risks. CPC carries 80%+ of Kazakh oil exports (>1% global supply). Fourth tanker in four days hit — Nelsa struck 20 Jul while loading, fire aboard, 22 crew evacuated. Also Nordic Zenith (Fri). CPC pipeline (1,510km) from Tengiz/Kashagan/Karachaganak to Black Sea. Kazakh FM condemned strikes as "deliberate actions aimed at destabilizing global energy markets." (Ref: Euronews "Four drone strikes in four days"; Bloomberg 20 Jul.)
